                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "<?php\n\ndeclare(strict_types=1);\n\nnamespace App\\Livewire\\Shared;\n\nuse App\\Jobs\\RecordSponsoredContentEventJob;\nuse App\\Models\\SponsoredContent;\nuse Illuminate\\Contracts\\View\\View;\nuse Illuminate\\Database\\Eloquent\\Collection;\nuse Livewire\\Attributes\\Locked;\nuse Livewire\\Component;\n\nfinal class SponsoredContentBanner extends Component\n{\n    #[Locked]\n    public string $placement;\n\n    /**\n     * Rendering orientation: \"wide\" renders a single weighted banner,\n     * \"tall\" renders a rotating carousel of all tall-creative items.\n     */\n    #[Locked]\n    public string $orientation = 'wide';\n\n    /** Selected content ID for the wide single-pick render. */\n    #[Locked]\n    public ?int $selectedContentId = null;\n\n    /** Ordered IDs for the tall carousel render (used server-side for impression tracking). */\n    #[Locked]\n    public array $carouselIds = [];\n\n    public function mount(string $placement, string $orientation = 'wide'): void\n    {\n        $this->placement = $placement;\n        $this->orientation = $orientation;\n\n        if (! config('marketplace.features.sponsored_content_enabled')) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if ($this->orientation === 'tall' || $this->orientation === 'row') {\n            $this->initCarousel();\n        } else {\n            $this->initSinglePick();\n        }\n    }\n\n    public function render(): View\n    {\n        $content = null;\n        $carouselItems = collect();\n\n        if ($this->orientation === 'tall' || $this->orientation === 'row') {\n            /** @var Collection<int, SponsoredContent> $carouselItems */\n            $carouselItems = SponsoredContent::with(['tier', 'tallMedia'])\n                ->whereIn('id', $this->carouselIds)\n                ->get()\n                ->sortBy(fn ($c) => array_search($c->id, $this->carouselIds, true));\n        } else {\n            $content = $this->selectedContentId\n                ? SponsoredContent::with('wideMedia')->find($this->selectedContentId)\n                : null;\n        }\n\n        return view('livewire.shared.sponsored-content-banner', [\n            'content' => $content,\n            'carouselItems' => $carouselItems,\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    // ── Private helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n    private function initSinglePick(): void\n    {\n        $selected = $this->selectWeighted();\n\n        if ($selected) {\n            $this->selectedContentId = $selected->id;\n            RecordSponsoredContentEventJob::dispatch($selected->id, 'impression');\n        }\n    }\n\n    private function initCarousel(): void\n    {\n        /** @var Collection<int, SponsoredContent> $items */\n        $items = SponsoredContent::with('tier')\n            ->active()\n            ->forPlacement($this->placement)\n            ->whereNotNull('tall_media_id')\n            ->orderByDesc('id')\n            ->get();\n\n        if ($items->isEmpty()) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Store IDs; dispatch impressions for all items shown in the carousel.\n        $this->carouselIds = $items->pluck('id')->toArray();\n\n        foreach ($this->carouselIds as $id) {\n            RecordSponsoredContentEventJob::dispatch($id, 'impression');\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Tier-weighted random selection for the wide single-pick variant.\n     */\n    private function selectWeighted(): ?SponsoredContent\n    {\n        $candidates = SponsoredContent::with(['tier', 'wideMedia'])\n            ->active()\n            ->forPlacement($this->placement)\n            ->whereNotNull('wide_media_id')\n            ->get();\n\n        if ($candidates->isEmpty()) {\n            return null;\n        }\n\n        $totalWeight = $candidates->sum(fn ($c) => $c->tier?->priority_weight ?? 1);\n\n        if ($totalWeight <= 0) {\n            return $candidates->random();\n        }\n\n        $random = random_int(1, $totalWeight);\n        $cumulative = 0;\n\n        foreach ($candidates as $candidate) {\n            $cumulative += $candidate->tier?->priority_weight ?? 1;\n            if ($random <= $cumulative) {\n                return $candidate;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return $candidates->first();\n    }\n}"

            "kind": "text",
            "data": "Good — I have enough context. A few clarifying questions before I start:\n\n**1. Carousel slides — what's fixed vs. dynamic?**\nThe mockup shows 5 slides: MHCB badge, brand (\"1HG\"), Ismail Abaya, and 2 sponsored ads. My plan:\n- Slides 1 & 2 (MHCB + brand) — hardcoded in the template, using the real images you already have (`/images/halal-stamp.png`, `/images/halal_store_main_logo.png`, `/images/ismail_abaya_phd.png`)\n- Slide 3 (Ismail Abaya) — hardcoded with his real photo\n- Slides 4+ (sponsored) — pulled from `SponsoredContentBanner` with `placement=\"homepage\" orientation=\"tall\"`\n\nIs this breakdown right, or should the sponsored content slot be handled differently (e.g. a separate section after the hero instead of inside the carousel)?\n\n**2. Search bar placement**\nThe mockup shows the floating search panel moved to align below the right (carousel) column specifically. On mobile where the carousel is hidden, should the search:\n- a) Stay full-width below the hero as it is now, or\n- b) Move inside/below the hero section (no negative margin offset), or\n- c) Something else?\n\n**3.                   "data": "<div>\n@if (config('marketplace.features.sponsored_content_enabled'))\n\n    {{-- ══ WIDE / SINGLE PICK ════════════════════════════════════════════\n         Default transition-transform duration-300\"\n                    style=\"aspect-ratio: 4/1;\"\n                    loading=\"lazy\"\n                />\n                <div class=\"absolute top-2 left-2\">\n bottom-0 inset-x-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/70 to-transparent px-4 py-3\">\n                    <p class=\"text-sm font-semibold text-white truncate\">{{ $content->title }}</p>\n                </div>\n            </a>\n        </div>\n\n    {{-- ══ TALL / CAROUSEL ═══════════════════════════════════════════════\n         Hero variant: tall-format ad cards in an auto-rotating carousel.\n },\n                go(idx) { this.current = idx; clearInterval(this.interval); this.start(); }\n            }\"\n            x-init=\"start()\"\n            @mouseenter=\"stop()\"\n            @mouseleave=\"start()\"\n            class=\"relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl\"\n            style=\"aspect-ratio: 2/3;\"\n            aria-label=\"{{ __('Sponsored content carousel') }}\"\n        >\n            @foreach ($carouselItems as $idx => $item)\n                @if ($item->tallMedia)\n                    <a\n                        href=\"{{ route('sponsored-content.click', $item) }}\"\n                        target=\"_blank\"\n                        rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\n                        x-show=\"current === {{ $idx }}\"\n                        x-transition:enter=\"transition ease-out duration-500\"\n                        x-transition:enter-start=\"opacity-0 scale-105\"\n                        x-transition:enter-end=\"opacity-100 scale-100\"\n                        x-transition:leave=\"transition ease-in duration-300\"\n                        x-transition:leave-start=\"opacity-100 scale-100\"\n                        x-transition:leave-end=\"opacity-0 scale-95\"\n                        class=\"absolute inset-0 block\"\n                        aria-label=\"{{ __('Sponsored: :title', ['title' => $item->title]) }}\"\n                    >\n                        <img\n                            src=\"{{ route('media.view', $item->tallMedia) }}\"\n                            alt=\"{{ $item->title }}\"\n                            class=\"w-full h-full object-cover\"\n                            loading=\"{{ $idx === 0 ? 'eager' : 'lazy' }}\"\n                        />\n                        <div class=\"absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/70 via-transparent to-transparent\"></div>\n                        <div class=\"absolute top-3 left-3\">\n                            <span class=\"inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full bg-black/50 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-white backdrop-blur-sm\">\n                                <flux:icon name=\"megaphone\" class=\"size-3\" />\n                                {{ __('Sponsored') }}\n                            </span>\n                        </div>\n                        <div class=\"absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 px-4 py-4\">\n                            <p class=\"text-sm font-semibold text-white leading-snug line-clamp-2\">{{ $item->title }}</p>\n                        </div>\n                    </a>\n                @endif\n            @endforeach\n            @if ($carouselItems->count() > 1)\n                <div class=\"absolute bottom-3 inset-x-0 flex justify-center gap-1.5 z-10\">\n                    @foreach ($carouselItems as $idx => $item)\n                        <button\n                            type=\"button\"\n                            x-on:click=\"go({{ $idx }})\"\n                            x-bind:class=\"current === {{ $idx }} ? + 1]) }}\"\n                        ></button>\n                    @endforeach\n                </div>\n            @endif\n        </div>\n\n    {{-- ══ ROW / HORIZONTAL STRIP ════════════════════════════════════════\n         Homepage section: 4–6 portrait cards side-by-side.\n         The visible window advances by one card every 5 s, wrapping around\n         the full pool so every ad gets equal airtime.\n    ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ --}}\n    @elseif ($orientation === 'row' && $carouselItems->isNotEmpty())\n        @php\n            // Repeat the pool so the sliding window always has enough cards\n            // even when there are fewer ads than the visible count (min 6 slots).\n            $pool     = $carouselItems->filter(fn ($c) => $c->tallMedia)->values();\n            $poolSize = $pool->count();\n        @endphp\n        @if ($poolSize > 0)\n        <div class=\"w-full my-4\">\n            {{-- Section label --}}\n            <div class=\"flex items-center justify-between mb-3\">\n                <span class=\"inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--hs-neutral-500)]\">\n                    <flux:icon name=\"megaphone\" class=\"size-3.5\" />\n                    {{ __('Sponsored') }}\n                </span>\n            </div>\n\n            {{--\n                Alpine state:\n                  offset   — index of the leftmost visible card (in the REPEATED pool)\n                  visible  — how many cards fit (6 lg, 4 md, 2 sm — driven by CSS, JS reads it)\n                  items    — the server-rendered pool as a JS array of {href, src, alt, title}\n            --}}\n            <div\n                x-data=\"{\n                    offset: 0,\n                    interval: null,\n                    paused: false,\n                    cols: 2,\n                    items: {{ Js::from($pool->map(fn ($c) => [\n                        'href'  => route('sponsored-content.click', $c),\n                        'src'   => route('media.view', $c->tallMedia),\n                        'alt'   => $c->title,\n                        'title' => $c->title,\n                    ])->values()->all()) }},\n                    get total() { return this.items.length; },\n                    updateCols() {\n                        const w = window.innerWidth;\n                        if (w >= 1024)     this.cols = 6;\n                        else if (w >= 640) this.cols = 4;\n                        else               this.cols = 2;\n                    },\n                    item(i) {\n                        return this.items[(this.offset + i) % this.total];\n                    },\n                    advance() {\n                        this.offset = (this.offset + 1) % this.total;\n                    },\n                    start() {\n                        if (this.total <= 1) return;\n                        this.interval = setInterval(() => { if (!this.paused) this.advance(); }, 5000);\n                    },\n                    stop() { clearInterval(this.interval); }\n                }\"\n                x-init=\"\n                    updateCols();\n                    window.addEventListener('resize', () => updateCols());\n                    start();\n                \"\n                @mouseenter=\"paused = true\"\n                @mouseleave=\"paused = false\"\n                class=\"grid gap-3\"\n                x-bind:style=\"'grid-template-columns: repeat(' + cols + ', minmax(0,1fr));'\"\n                aria-label=\"{{ __('Sponsored content') }}\"\n            >\n                {{--\n                    We always render visibleCount() slots. Since visibleCount() is\n                    determined at runtime in Alpine we render up to 6 items and hide\n                    extras via CSS. Alpine swaps src/href as offset changes.\n                --}}\n                <template x-for=\"i in [0,1,2,3,4,5]\" :key=\"i\">\n                    <a\n                        x-show=\"i < cols && total > 0\"\n                        x-bind:href=\"total > 0 ? item(i).href : '#'\"\n                        target=\"_blank\"\n                        rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"\n                        class=\"group relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-[var(--hs-neutral-200)] shadow-[var(--hs-shadow-sm)] hover:shadow-[var(--hs-shadow-md)] transition-shadow bg-[var(--hs-neutral-100)]\"\n                        style=\"aspect-ratio: 2/3;\"\n                        x-bind:aria-label=\"total > 0 ? item(i).title : ''\"\n                    >\n                        <img\n                            x-bind:src=\"total > 0 ? item(i).src : ''\"\n                            x-bind:alt=\"total > 0 ? item(i).alt : ''\"\n                            class=\"w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-[1.03] transition-transform duration-500\"\n                            loading=\"lazy\"\n                        />\n                        <div class=\"absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 via-transparent to-transparent\"></div>\n                        <div class=\"absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 px-3 py-3\">\n                            <p class=\"text-xs font-semibold text-white leading-snug line-clamp-2\"\n                               x-text=\"total > 0 ? item(i).title : ''\"></p>\n                        </div>\n                    </a>\n                </template>\n            </div>\n        </div>\n        @endif\n    @endif\n\n@endif\n</div>"

                  "kind": "text",
                  "data": "/**\n * Halal B2B Marketplace — Design System Tokens\n *\n * Brand palette, neutrals, semantic colors, typography, spacing, radius, elevation, and motion.\n *\n * Brand colors updated per new palette spec:\n *   Primary Base     — Deep Emerald Green  #00312B  (brand headers, primary buttons, dark surfaces)\n *   Accent/Secondary — Vibrant Gold Yellow #EEC900  (highlights, badges, CTAs on dark green)\n *   Neutral Light    — Soft Off-White      #EFEFEF  (card backgrounds, light surface fills, borders)\n *   Neutral Dark     — Canvas Black        #000000  (high-contrast text, outer margins, dark mode)\n *\n * Usage: these CSS custom properties are consumed by Tailwind via @theme in app.css.\n */\n\n:root {\n    /* ===========================\n       BRAND — Deep Emerald Green\n       (scale built around #00312B as the 600/\"Primary\" step)\n       =========================== */\n    --hs-green-50: #F2F5F4;\n    --hs-green-100: #D9E0DF;\n    --hs-green-200: #B3C1BF;\n    --hs-green-300: #8CA2A0;\n    --hs-green-400: #597875;\n    --hs-green-500: #26504B;\n    --hs-green-600: #00312B; /* Primary — Deep Emerald Green */\n    --hs-green-700: #002924;\n    --hs-green-800: #00221E;\n    --hs-green-900: #001B18;\n    --hs-green-950: #001311; /* Deep forest — hero/footer/dark surfaces */\n\n    /* ===========================\n       ACCENT — Vibrant Gold Yellow\n       (scale built around #EEC900 as the 500 step)\n       =========================== */\n    --hs-gold-100: #FDFAE6;\n    --hs-gold-200: #FBF1BF;\n    --hs-gold-300: #F7E78C;\n    --hs-gold-400: #F3D94D;\n    --hs-gold-500: #EEC900; /* Accent — Vibrant Gold Yellow */\n    --hs-gold-600: #CAAB00;\n    --hs-gold-700: #A68D00;\n    --hs-gold-800: #836F00;\n    --hs-gold-900: #5F5000;\n\n    /* ===========================\n       NEUTRALS — Soft Off-White to Canvas Black\n       =========================== */\n    --hs-neutral-0: #FFFFFF;\n    --hs-neutral-50: #EFEFEF;  /* Soft Off-White — card/surface fills */\n    --hs-neutral-100: #E0E0E0;\n    --hs-neutral-200: #C7C7C7;\n    --hs-neutral-300: #A8A8A8;\n    --hs-neutral-400: #8A8A8A;\n    --hs-neutral-500: #6B6B6B;\n    --hs-neutral-600: #4D4D4D;\n    --hs-neutral-700: #333333;\n    --hs-neutral-800: #1A1A1A;\n    --hs-neutral-900: #000000; /* Canvas Black */\n\n    /* ===========================\n       SEMANTIC COLORS\n       =========================== */\n    --hs-success-50: #ECFDF5;\n    --hs-success-100: #D1FAE5;\n    --hs-success-200: #A7F3D0;\n    --hs-success-500: #10B981;\n    --hs-success-700: #047857;\n    --hs-success-800: #065F46;\n\n    --hs-warning-50: #FFFBEB;\n    --hs-warning-100: #FEF3C7;\n    --hs-warning-200: #FDE68A;\n    --hs-warning-500: #F59E0B;\n    --hs-warning-700: #B45309;\n    --hs-warning-800: #92400E;\n\n    --hs-danger-50: #FEF2F2;\n    --hs-danger-100: #FEE2E2;\n    --hs-danger-200: #FECACA;\n    --hs-danger-500: #EF4444;\n    --hs-danger-700: #B91C1C;\n    --hs-danger-800: #991B1B;\n\n    --hs-info-50: #EFF6FF;\n    --hs-info-100: #DBEAFE;\n    --hs-info-200: #BFDBFE;\n    --hs-info-500: #3B82F6;\n    --hs-info-700: #1D4ED8;\n    --hs-info-800: #1E40AF;\n\n    /* ===========================\n       TYPOGRAPHY\n       =========================== */\n    --hs-font-display: 'Sora', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;\n    --hs-font-body: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;\n\n    /* Type scale */\n    --hs-text-xs: 0.75rem; Illuminate\\Database\\Eloquent\\Relations\\BelongsTo;\nuse Illuminate\\Database\\Eloquent\\Relations\\HasMany;\nuse Illuminate\\Support\\Carbon;\n\n/**\n * @property int $id\n * @property int $sponsored_content_tier_id\n * @property string $title\n * @property int|null $media_id\n * @property int|null $wide_media_id\n * @property int|null $tall_media_id\n * @property string $destination_url\n * @property Carbon $starts_at\n * @property Carbon $ends_at\n * @property bool $is_active\n * @property int $created_by\n * @property Carbon|null $created_at\n * @property Carbon|null $updated_at\n */\nfinal class SponsoredContent extends Model\n{\n    protected $table = 'sponsored_content';\n\n    protected $fillable = [\n        'sponsored_content_tier_id',\n        'title',\n        'media_id',\n        'wide_media_id',\n        'tall_media_id',\n        'destination_url',\n        'starts_at',\n        'ends_at',\n        'is_active',\n        'created_by',\n    ];\n\n    public function tier(): BelongsTo\n    {\n        return $this->belongsTo(SponsoredContentTier::class, 'sponsored_content_tier_id');\n    }\n\n    public function media(): BelongsTo\n    {\n        return $this->belongsTo(Media::class);\n    }\n\n    public function wideMedia(): BelongsTo\n    {\n        return $this->belongsTo(Media::class, 'wide_media_id');\n    }\n\n    public function tallMedia(): BelongsTo\n    {\n        return $this->belongsTo(Media::class, 'tall_media_id');\n    }\n\n    public function createdBy(): BelongsTo\n    {\n        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'created_by');\n    }\n\n    public function placements(): HasMany\n    {\n        return $this->hasMany(SponsoredContentPlacement::class);\n    }\n\n    public function events(): HasMany\n    {\n        return $this->hasMany(SponsoredContentEvent::class);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Scope to content that is currently active and within its schedule window.\n     *\n     * @param  Builder<SponsoredContent>  $query\n     * @return Builder<SponsoredContent>\n     */\n    public function scopeActive(Builder $query): Builder\n    {\n        return $query\n            ->where('is_active', true)\n            ->where('starts_at', '<=', now())\n            ->where('ends_at', '>=', now());\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Scope to content targeting a specific placement key.\n     *\n     * @param  Builder<SponsoredContent>  $query\n     * @return Builder<SponsoredContent>\n     */\n    public function scopeForPlacement(Builder $query, string $placementKey): Builder\n    {\n        return $query->whereHas('placements', fn (Builder $q) => $q->where('placement_key', $placementKey));\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @return array<string, string>\n     */\n    protected function                   "data": "<?php\n\ndeclare(strict_types=1);\n\nnamespace App\\Livewire\\Admin\\SponsoredContent;\n\nuse App\\Livewire\\Forms\\SponsoredContentForm;\nuse App\\Models\\SponsoredContent;\nuse App\\Models\\SponsoredContentPlacement;\nuse App\\Models\\SponsoredContentTier;\nuse App\\Services\\MediaUploadService;\nuse Illuminate\\Contracts\\View\\View;\nuse Illuminate\\Database\\Eloquent\\Collection;\nuse Illuminate\\Support\\Facades\\Auth;\nuse Illuminate\\Support\\Facades\\Gate;\nuse Livewire\\Attributes\\Computed;\nuse Livewire\\Attributes\\Layout;\nuse Livewire\\Attributes\\Locked;\nuse Livewire\\Attributes\\Title;\nuse Livewire\\Component;\nuse Livewire\\Features\\SupportFileUploads\\TemporaryUploadedFile;\nuse Livewire\\WithFileUploads;\n\n#[Layout('layouts.portal', ['portal' => 'admin'])]\n#[Title('Sponsored Content Composer')]\nfinal class SponsoredContentComposer extends Component\n{\n    use WithFileUploads;\n\n    /** @var list<string> */\n    public const array PLACEMENT_KEYS = ['homepage', 'category_page', 'search_results'];\n\n    /**\n     * Recommended pixel dimensions for each creative orientation.\n     * Shown as a hint next to the dropzone labels.\n     */\n    public const array CREATIVE_DIMENSIONS = [\n        'wide' => '1200 × 300 px',\n        'tall' => '400 × 600 px',\n    ];\n\n    public SponsoredContentForm $form;\n\n    #[Locked]\n    public ?int $contentId = null;\n\n    /** @var TemporaryUploadedFile|null */\n    public mixed $wideCreative = null;\n\n    /** @var TemporaryUploadedFile|null */\n    public mixed $tallCreative = null;\n\n    public function mount(?SponsoredContent $sponsoredContent = null): void\n    {\n        Gate::authorize('sponsored_content.manage');\n\n        if ($sponsoredContent && $sponsoredContent->exists) {\n            $this->contentId = $sponsoredContent->id;\n            $this->form->setSponsoredContent($sponsoredContent->load('placements'));\n        }\n    }\n\n    /** @return Collection<int, SponsoredContentTier> */\n    #[Computed]\n    public function tiers(): Collection\n    {\n        return SponsoredContentTier::where('is_active', true)\n            ->orderBy('priority_weight', 'desc')\n            ->get();\n    }\n\n    public function save(MediaUploadService $uploader): void\n    {\n        Gate::authorize('sponsored_content.manage');\n\n        $hasExistingWide = (bool) $this->form->wideMediaId;\n        $hasExistingTall = (bool) $this->form->tallMediaId;\n\n        $this->validate([\n            'wideCreative' => $hasExistingWide\n                ? ['nullable', 'file', 'max:20480', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,webp']\n                : ['nullable', 'file', 'max:20480', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,webp'],\n            'tallCreative' => $hasExistingTall\n                ? ['nullable', 'file', 'max:20480', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,webp']\n                : ['nullable', 'file', 'max:20480', 'mimes:jpg,jpeg,png,webp'],\n        ]);\n\n        // At least one creative must be present (either existing or newly uploaded).\n        if (! $hasExistingWide && ! $this->wideCreative && ! $hasExistingTall && ! $this->tallCreative) {\n            $this->addError('wideCreative', __('Please upload at least one creative image (wide or tall).'));\n\n            return;\n        }\n\n        $this->form->validate();\n\n        if ($this->wideCreative) {\n            $media = $uploader->store($this->wideCreative, Auth::id(), 'Sponsored content – wide creative');\n            $this->form->wideMediaId = $media->id;\n        }\n\n        if ($this->tallCreative) {\n            $media = $uploader->store($this->tallCreative, Auth::id(), 'Sponsored content – tall creative');\n            $this->form->tallMediaId = $media->id;\n        }\n\n        $data = [\n            'sponsored_content_tier_id' => (int) $this->form->tierId,\n            'title' => $this->form->title,\n            'wide_media_id' => $this->form->wideMediaId,\n            'tall_media_id' => $this->form->tallMediaId,\n            'destination_url' => $this->form->destinationUrl,\n            'starts_at' => $this->form->startsAt,\n            'ends_at' => $this->form->endsAt,\n            'is_active' => $this->form->isActive,\n            'created_by' => Auth::id(),\n        ];\n\n        if ($this->contentId) {\n            $content = SponsoredContent::findOrFail($this->contentId);\n            $content->update($data);\n            $content->placements()->delete();\n        } else {\n            $content = SponsoredContent::create($data);\n        }\n\n        foreach ($this->form->placements as $key) {\n            SponsoredContentPlacement::create([\n                'sponsored_content_id' => $content->id,\n                'placement_key' => $key,\n            ]);\n        }\n\n        $this->redirect(route('admin.sponsored-content.index'), navigate: true);\n    }\n\n    public function render(): View\n    {\n        return view('livewire.admin.sponsored-content.sponsored-content-composer');\n    }\n}"

                  "data": "<?php\n\ndeclare(strict_types=1);\n\nnamespace Database\\Seeders;\n\nuse App\\Models\\Media;\nuse App\\Models\\SponsoredContent;\nuse App\\Models\\SponsoredContentPlacement;\nuse App\\Models\\SponsoredContentTier;\nuse App\\Models\\User;\nuse Illuminate\\Database\\Seeder;\nuse Illuminate\\Support\\Facades\\Storage;\nuse Illuminate\\Support\\Str;\n\n/**\n * Seeds a full row of sponsored content demo entries — one per tier.\n *\n * Each entry gets both a wide creative (1200×300) and a tall creative (400×600)\n * as in-memory generated placeholder PNG images stored in S3/Minio.\n * All entries target the \"homepage\" placement and are scheduled as currently live.\n */\nfinal class SponsoredContentSeeder extends Seeder\n{\n    /**\n     * Wide creative aspect ratio in pixels.\n     * Best display: 1200 × 300 px (4:1)\n     */\n    private const int WIDE_W = 1200;\n\n    private const int WIDE_H = 300;\n\n    /**\n     * Tall creative aspect ratio in pixels.\n     * Best display: 400 × 600 px (2:3)\n     */\n    private const int TALL_W = 400;\n\n    private const int TALL_H = 600;\n\n    /**\n     * Demo entries. Each maps to one ad record with both creatives.\n     *\n     * @var list<array{\n     *     title: string,\n     *     destination_url: string,\n     *     tier: string,\n     *     placements: list<string>,\n     *     wide_bg: int[],\n     *     tall_bg: int[],\n     *     label: string,\n     * }>\n     */\n    private const array ENTRIES = [\n        [\n            'title' => 'Al Barakah Foods — Ramadan Super Sale',\n            'destination_url' => 'https://albarakahfoods.example.com',\n            'tier' => 'Gold',\n            'placements' => ['homepage', 'search_results'],\n            'wide_bg' => [24, 71, 40],   // dark green\n            'tall_bg' => [15, 50, 28],\n            'label' => 'Al Barakah Foods',\n        ],\n        [\n            'title' => 'Majestic Halal Meat Co. — Premium Cuts',\n            'destination_url' => 'https://majestichalalco.example.com',\n            'tier' => 'Gold',\n            'placements' => ['homepage', 'category_page'],\n            'wide_bg' => [120, 36, 20],  // deep red\n            'tall_bg' => [90, 22, 10],\n            'label' => 'Majestic Halal',\n        ],\n        [\n            'title' => 'Salam Spice Traders — New Arrivals',\n            'destination_url' => 'https://salamspice.example.com',\n            'tier' => 'Silver',\n            'placements' => ['homepage', 'search_results'],\n            'wide_bg' => [140, 90, 10],  // amber\n            'tall_bg' => [100, 65, 5],\n            'label' => 'Salam Spice',\n        ],\n        [\n            'title' => 'HalalFresh PH — Farm-to-Table Delivery',\n            'destination_url' => 'https://halalfresh.example.com',\n            'tier' => 'Silver',\n            'placements' => ['homepage'],\n            'wide_bg' => [20, 100, 60],  // emerald\n            'tall_bg' => [10, 75, 45],\n            'label' => 'HalalFresh PH',\n        ],\n        [\n            'title' => 'Nur Logistics — Halal Cold Chain',\n            'destination_url' => 'https://nurlogistics.example.com',\n            'tier' => 'Bronze',\n            'placements' => ['homepage', 'category_page'],\n            'wide_bg' => [45, 70, 110],  // blue-steel\n            'tall_bg' => [30, 50, 85],\n            'label' => 'Nur Logistics',\n        ],\n        [\n            'title' => 'Berkah Dairy — Halal Cheese & Yogurt',\n            'destination_url' => 'https://berkahdairy.example.com',\n            'tier' => 'Bronze',\n            'placements' => ['homepage'],\n            'wide_bg' => [170, 130, 40], // warm gold\n            'tall_bg' => [130, 95, 20],\n            'label' => 'Berkah Dairy',\n        ],\n    ];\n\n    public function run(): void\n    {\n        // Ensure tiers exist.\n        (new SponsoredContentTierSeeder)->run();\n\n        /** @var User $uploader */\n        $uploader = User::first() ?? User::factory()->create();\n\n        foreach (self::ENTRIES as $entry) {\n            // Skip if already seeded (idempotent by title).\n            if (SponsoredContent::where('title', $entry['title'])->exists()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            $tier = SponsoredContentTier::where('name', $entry['tier'])->first();\n\n            if (! $tier) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            $wideMedia = $this->createPlaceholderMedia(\n                $uploader->id,\n                self::WIDE_W,\n                self::WIDE_H,\n                $entry['wide_bg'],\n                $entry['label'].' — Wide',\n                'Sponsored content – wide creative',\n            );\n\n            $tallMedia = $this->createPlaceholderMedia(\n                $uploader->id,\n                self::TALL_W,\n                self::TALL_H,\n                $entry['tall_bg'],\n                $entry['label'].' — Tall',\n                'Sponsored content – tall creative',\n            );\n\n            $content = SponsoredContent::create([\n                'sponsored_content_tier_id' => $tier->id,\n                'title' => $entry['title'],\n                'wide_media_id' => $wideMedia->id,\n                'tall_media_id' => $tallMedia->id,\n                'destination_url' => $entry['destination_url'],\n                'starts_at' => now()->subDay(),\n                'ends_at' => now()->addMonths(3),\n                'is_active' => true,\n                'created_by' => $uploader->id,\n            ]);\n\n            foreach ($entry['placements'] as $key) {\n                SponsoredContentPlacement::create([\n                    'sponsored_content_id' => $content->id,\n                    'placement_key' => $key,\n                ]);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Generate an in-memory placeholder PNG and store it to S3, returning a Media record.\n     *\n     * @param  int[]  $bg  [r, g, b]\n     */\n    private function createPlaceholderMedia(\n        int $uploaderId,\n        int $width,\n        int $height,\n        array $bg,\n        string $text,\n        string $description,\n    ): Media {\n        $png = $this->generatePlaceholderPng($width, $height, $bg, $text);\n\n        $uuid = Str::uuid()->toString();\n        $datePrefix = now()->format('Y/m/d');\n        $filename = Str::slug($text).'-'.$uuid.'.png';\n        $storagePath = \"media/{$datePrefix}/{$filename}\";\n\n        Storage::disk('s3')->put($storagePath, $png, 'private');\n\n        return Media::create([\n            'original_filename' => $filename,\n            'extension' => 'png',\n            'storage_path' => $storagePath,\n            'mime_type' => 'image/png',\n            'description' => $description,\n            'scan_status' => 'clean',\n            'uploaded_by_id' => $uploaderId,\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Generate a minimal solid-colour PNG with a centred label using PHP GD.\n     * Returns raw PNG bytes.\n     *\n     * @param  int[]  $bg  [r, g, b]\n     */\n    private function generatePlaceholderPng(int $width, int $height, array $bg, string $label): string\n    {\n        $img = imagecreatetruecolor($width, $height);\n\n        $bgColor = imagecolorallocate($img, $bg[0], $bg[1], $bg[2]);\n        $textColor = imagecolorallocate($img, 255, 255, 255);\n        $accentColor = imagecolorallocate($img, 212, 163, 36); // gold\n\n        imagefill($img, 0, 0, $bgColor);\n\n        // Thin gold border\n        imagerectangle($img, 4, 4, $width - 5, $height - 5, $accentColor);\n\n        // Centred label (built-in font size 5 = 9×15 px per char)\n        $fontW = 9;\n        $fontH = 15;\n        $labelLen = mb_strlen($label);\n        $textW = $labelLen * $fontW;\n        $x = max(0, (int) (($width - $textW) / 2));\n        $y = (int) (($height - $fontH) / 2);\n        imagestring($img, 5, $x, $y, $label, $textColor);\n\n        // Sponsored tag below label\n        $tag = '[ SPONSORED DEMO ]';\n        $tagW = mb_strlen($tag) * $fontW;\n        $tx = max(0, (int) (($width - $tagW) / 2));\n        imagestring($img, 3, $tx, $y + 20, $tag, $accentColor);\n\n        ob_start();\n        imagepng($img);\n        $png = ob_get_clean();\n        imagedestroy($img);\n\n        return $png ?: '';\n    }\n}"

'https://berkahdairy.example.com',\n            'tier' => 'Bronze',\n            'placements' => ['homepage'],\n            'wide_bg' => [170, 130, 40], // warm gold\n            'tall_bg' => [130, 95, 20],\n            'label' => 'Berkah Dairy',\n        ],\n    ];\n\n    public function run(): void\n    {\n        // Ensure tiers exist.\n        (new SponsoredContentTierSeeder)->run();\n\n        /** @var User $uploader */\n        $uploader = User::first() ?? User::factory()->create();\n\n        foreach (self::ENTRIES as $entry) {\n            // Skip if already seeded (idempotent by title).\n            if (SponsoredContent::where('title', $entry['title'])->exists()) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            $tier = SponsoredContentTier::where('name', $entry['tier'])->first();\n\n            if (! $tier) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            $wideMedia = $this->createPlaceholderMedia(\n                $uploader->id,\n                self::WIDE_W,\n                self::WIDE_H,\n                $entry['wide_bg'],\n                $entry['label'].' — Wide',\n                'Sponsored content – wide creative',\n            );\n\n            $tallMedia = $this->createPlaceholderMedia(\n                $uploader->id,\n                self::TALL_W,\n                self::TALL_H,\n                $entry['tall_bg'],\n                $entry['label'].' — Tall',\n                'Sponsored content – tall creative',\n            );\n\n            $content = SponsoredContent::create([\n                'sponsored_content_tier_id' => $tier->id,\n                'title' => $entry['title'],\n                'wide_media_id' => $wideMedia->id,\n                'tall_media_id' => $tallMedia->id,\n                'destination_url' => $entry['destination_url'],\n                'starts_at' => now()->subDay(),\n                'ends_at' => now()->addMonths(3),\n                'is_active' => true,\n                'created_by' => $uploader->id,\n            ]);\n\n            foreach ($entry['placements'] as $key) {\n                SponsoredContentPlacement::create([\n                    'sponsored_content_id' => $content->id,\n                    'placement_key' => $key,\n                ]);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Generate an in-memory placeholder PNG and store it to S3, returning a Media record.\n     *\n     * @param  int[]  $bg  [r, g, b]\n     */\n    private function createPlaceholderMedia(\n        int $uploaderId,\n        int $width,\n        int $height,\n        array $bg,\n        string $text,\n        string $description,\n    ): Media {\n        $png = $this->generatePlaceholderPng($width, $height, $bg, $text);\n\n        $uuid = Str::uuid()->toString();\n        $datePrefix = now()->format('Y/m/d');\n        $filename = Str::slug($text).'-'.$uuid.'.png';\n        $storagePath = \"media/{$datePrefix}/{$filename}\";\n\n        Storage::disk('s3')->put($storagePath, $png, 'private');\n\n        return Media::create([\n            'original_filename' => $filename,\n            'extension' => 'png',\n            'storage_path' => $storagePath,\n            'mime_type' => 'image/png',\n            'description' => $description,\n            'scan_status' => 'clean',\n            'uploaded_by_id' => $uploaderId,\n        ]);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * Generate a minimal solid-colour PNG with a centred label using PHP GD.\n     * Returns raw PNG bytes.\n     *\n     * @param  int[]  $bg  [r, g, b]\n     */\n    private function generatePlaceholderPng(int $width, int $height, array $bg, string $label): string\n    {\n        $img = imagecreatetruecolor($width, $height);\n\n        $bgColor = imagecolorallocate($img, $bg[0], $bg[1], $bg[2]);\n        $textColor = imagecolorallocate($img, 255, 255, 255);\n        $accentColor = imagecolorallocate($img, 212, 163, 36); // gold\n\n        imagefill($img, 0, 0, $bgColor);\n\n        // Thin gold border\n        imagerectangle($img, 4, 4, $width - 5, $height - 5, $accentColor);\n\n        // Centred label (built-in font size 5 = 9×15 px per char)\n        $fontW = 9;\n        $fontH = 15;\n        $labelLen = mb_strlen($label);\n        $textW = $labelLen * $fontW;\n        $x = max(0, (int) (($width - $textW) / 2));\n        $y = (int) (($height - $fontH) / 2);\n        imagestring($img, 5, $x, $y, $label, $textColor);\n\n        // Sponsored tag below label\n        $tag = '[ SPONSORED DEMO ]';\n        $tagW = mb_strlen($tag) * $fontW;\n        $tx = max(0, (int) (($width - $tagW) / 2));\n        imagestring($img, 3, $tx, $y + 20, $tag, $accentColor);\n\n        ob_start();\n        imagepng($img);\n        $png = ob_get_clean();\n        imagedestroy($img);\n\n        return $png ?: '';\n    }\n}"

                  "data": "<?php\n\ndeclare(strict_types=1);\n\nnamespace App\\Livewire\\Forms;\n\nuse App\\Models\\SponsoredContent;\nuse Livewire\\Attributes\\Validate;\nuse Livewire\\Form;\n\nfinal class SponsoredContentForm extends Form\n{\n    #[Validate('required|string|max:255')]\n    public string $title = '';\n\n    #[Validate('required|url|max:500')]\n    public string $destinationUrl = '';\n\n    #[Validate('required|exists:sponsored_content_tiers,id')]\n    public ?string $tierId = null;\n\n    #[Validate('required|date|before:endsAt')]\n    public string $startsAt = '';\n\n    #[Validate('required|date|after:startsAt')]\n    public string $endsAt = '';\n\n    #[Validate('boolean')]\n    public bool $isActive = true;\n\n    /**\n     * At least one placement must be selected.\n     *\n     * @var list<string>\n     */\n    #[Validate('required|array|min:1')]\n    public array $placements = [];\n\n    /** Saved media ID for the wide (landscape) creative. */\n    public ?int $wideMediaId = null;\n\n    /** Saved media ID for the tall (portrait) creative. */\n    public ?int $tallMediaId = null;\n\n    public function setSponsoredContent(SponsoredContent $content): void\n    {\n        $this->title = $content->title;\n        $this->destinationUrl = $content->destination_url;\n        $this->tierId = (string) $content->sponsored_content_tier_id;\n        $this->startsAt = $content->starts_at->format('Y-m-d\\TH:i');\n        $this->endsAt = $content->ends_at->format('Y-m-d\\TH:i');\n        $this->isActive = $content->is_active;\n        $this->placements = $content->placements->pluck('placement_key')->toArray();\n        $this->wideMediaId = $content->wide_media_id;\n        $this->tallMediaId = $content->tall_media_id;\n    }\n}"

                "command": "strReplace",
                "newStr": "    private function initCarousel(): void\n    {\n        $query = SponsoredContent::with('tier')\n            ->active()\n            ->forPlacement($this->placement);\n\n        if ($this->orientation === 'hero') {\n            $query->whereNotNull('hero_media_id');\n        } else {\n            $query->whereNotNull('tall_media_id');\n        }\n\n        /** @var Collection<int, SponsoredContent> $items */\n        $items = $query->orderByDesc('id')->get();\n\n        if ($items->isEmpty()) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Store IDs; dispatch impressions for all items shown in the carousel.\n        $this->carouselIds = $items->pluck('id')->toArray();\n\n        foreach ($this->carouselIds as $id) {\n            RecordSponsoredContentEventJob::dispatch($id, 'impression');\n        }\n    }",
